Rumor Village - third-party notices
===================================

Rumor Village itself is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE, next to
this file). It is built with, and ships, the third-party components listed
below. Each component stays under its own license; the full texts are in the
licenses/ folder.

There are four prebuilt packages:

  linux-cuda      Linux x64, CUDA 12.9 backend
  linux-vulkan    Linux x64, Vulkan backend
  windows-cuda    Windows x64, CUDA 12.9 backend
  windows-vulkan  Windows x64, Vulkan backend

Every package carries this same file and the same licenses/ folder. The line
"Included in" of each section says which packages actually contain the
component; a section that does not name your package does not apply to it.

The AI model is not inside any package: the game downloads it on first start
(see the last section).


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. llama.cpp and ggml
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Library that runs the language model on the GPU (llama.cpp,
             llama-common and ggml with its CPU, CUDA or Vulkan backend),
             statically linked into the rumor-village executable.
Version:     v0.9.0 (commit cd959bae99ff4bed22bef2604f45241c09bbb8c8)
Source:      https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     MIT - Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The ggml authors
Text:        licenses/llama.cpp-ggml-MIT.txt

llama.cpp contains code under other licenses, listed in sections 2 to 6.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. cpp-httplib (vendored by llama.cpp)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        HTTP server and client library; serves the game to the browser.
Version:     0.64.0
Source:      https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     MIT - Copyright (c) 2017 yhirose
Text:        licenses/cpp-httplib-MIT.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. JSON for Modern C++ (nlohmann/json)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        JSON library, used by the game engine and by llama.cpp.
Version:     3.12.0
Source:      https://github.com/nlohmann/json
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     MIT - Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Niels Lohmann
Text:        licenses/nlohmann-json-MIT.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. subprocess.h (vendored by llama.cpp)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Single-header library to start processes, compiled into
             llama-common.
Source:      https://github.com/sheredom/subprocess.h
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     The Unlicense (public domain dedication)
Text:        licenses/subprocess.h-Unlicense.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. llamafile sgemm and YaRN (code inside ggml)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Matrix multiplication kernels of the ggml CPU backend
             (ggml/src/ggml-cpu/llamafile/sgemm.cpp), and the YaRN rotary
             embedding algorithm (ggml-cpu/ops.cpp, ggml-cuda/rope.cu).
Source:      https://github.com/Mozilla-Ocho/llamafile
             https://github.com/jquesnelle/yarn
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     MIT - Copyright 2024 Mozilla Foundation
             MIT - Copyright (c) 2023 Jeffrey Quesnelle and Bowen Peng
Text:        licenses/llamafile-sgemm-MIT.txt
             licenses/YaRN-MIT.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. Unicode Character Database (data inside llama.cpp)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Unicode character tables used by the tokenizer
             (llama.cpp src/unicode-data.cpp, generated from the Unicode
             Character Database).
Source:      https://www.unicode.org/ucd/
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     Unicode License V3 - Copyright (c) 1991-2026 Unicode, Inc.
Text:        licenses/Unicode-3.0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. three.js
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        3D library of the game viewer (viewer/vendor/three/).
Version:     0.186.1
Source:      https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     MIT - Copyright (c) 2010-2026 three.js authors
Text:        licenses/three.js-MIT.txt (also viewer/vendor/three/LICENSE)


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. Kenney 3D models
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Characters, town and nature models of the game
             (viewer/assets/characters/, viewer/assets/town/), from the packs
             "Mini Characters" (2.0), "Fantasy Town Kit" (2.0) and
             "Nature Kit" (2.1).
Source:      https://kenney.nl
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0), public domain dedication
Text:        licenses/Kenney-Mini-Characters-CC0.txt
             licenses/Kenney-Fantasy-Town-Kit-CC0.txt
             licenses/Kenney-Nature-Kit-CC0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. Nunito font
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Font of the game interface (viewer/assets/fonts/), variable
             font, Latin and Latin Extended subsets, from
             @fontsource-variable/nunito 5.3.0.
Source:      https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan, windows-cuda, windows-vulkan
License:     SIL Open Font License 1.1
             Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors
Text:        licenses/Nunito-OFL-1.1.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
10. NVIDIA CUDA Runtime and CUDA BLAS libraries
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Libraries of the CUDA backend, shipped unmodified:
               Linux:   lib/libcudart.so.12, lib/libcublas.so.12,
                        lib/libcublasLt.so.12
               Windows: cudart64_12.dll, cublas64_12.dll, cublasLt64_12.dll
             They are used only by Rumor Village. They need an NVIDIA GPU
             and driver; the driver is not shipped.
Version:     CUDA Toolkit 12.9
Source:      https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit
Included in: linux-cuda, windows-cuda (ONLY the CUDA packages)
License:     NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit End User License Agreement. These files are
             distributable under its Attachment A. They are NOT covered by
             the MIT license of Rumor Village: you may not modify, reverse
             engineer or redistribute them on their own.
Text:        licenses/NVIDIA-CUDA-12.9-EULA-excerpt.txt
             Full agreement:
             https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.9.1/eula/index.html


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
11. NVIDIA CUDA Core Compute Libraries (CUB, Thrust, libcu++)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Header-only GPU libraries compiled into the CUDA backend of ggml
             (sorting, sums and scans).
Version:     CCCL 2.8 (the one in CUDA Toolkit 12.9)
Source:      https://github.com/NVIDIA/cccl
Included in: linux-cuda, windows-cuda (ONLY the CUDA packages)
License:     Apache License 2.0 (Thrust), Apache License 2.0 with LLVM
             Exceptions (libcu++), BSD 3-Clause (CUB)
Text:        licenses/NVIDIA-CCCL.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
12. Vulkan Loader (Khronos Vulkan-Loader)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        The Vulkan loader, shipped as lib/libvulkan.so.1 so that the
             game starts on systems without it. It finds the Vulkan driver of
             your graphics card. The Windows Vulkan package does not ship it:
             it uses the vulkan-1.dll that comes with the graphics driver.
Version:     1.3 (the one of the Ubuntu build image)
Source:      https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Loader
Included in: linux-vulkan (ONLY)
License:     Apache License 2.0; loader/cJSON.* and
             loader/dirent_on_windows.* under MIT
             Copyright 2015-2022 The Khronos Group Inc., Valve Corporation,
             LunarG, Inc. and others
Text:        licenses/Vulkan-Loader-LICENSE.txt
             licenses/Vulkan-Loader-copyright.txt (copyright of the Ubuntu
             package the library is taken from)
             licenses/Apache-2.0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13. Vulkan headers (Vulkan-Headers, Vulkan-Hpp)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        Vulkan API headers compiled into the Vulkan backend of ggml.
Source:      https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers
Included in: linux-vulkan, windows-vulkan
License:     Apache License 2.0 OR MIT
             Copyright 2015-2023 The Khronos Group Inc.
Text:        licenses/Vulkan-Headers-LICENSE.txt
             licenses/Apache-2.0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
14. GCC runtime libraries
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        The C++ standard library (libstdc++) and the GCC support
             library (libgcc), statically linked into the Linux executable,
             and the OpenMP runtime (libgomp) when it is in lib/.
Source:      https://gcc.gnu.org
Included in: linux-cuda, linux-vulkan (ONLY the Linux packages)
License:     GNU GPL version 3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1.
             The Exception allows these libraries to be combined with and
             distributed as part of programs under any license, such as
             Rumor Village.
Text:        licenses/GCC-Runtime-Library-Exception-3.1.txt
             GPL version 3: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
15. Microsoft C/C++ runtime
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        The runtime of the Microsoft C/C++ compiler (MSVC), statically
             linked into rumor-village.exe (/MT). No Microsoft runtime DLL is
             shipped, and nothing has to be installed.
Included in: windows-cuda, windows-vulkan (ONLY the Windows packages)
License:     Microsoft Visual Studio license terms; static linking into an
             application is allowed and needs no notice.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
16. The AI model (NOT included; downloaded on first start)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What:        gemma-4-E4B-it-rumor-Q4_K_M.gguf, fine-tuned for Rumor Village
             from Google's Gemma 4 E4B (gemma-4-E4B-it) and quantized to
             Q4_K_M (GGUF). Modified files: fine-tuning and conversion. Its
             name, size, SHA-256 and origin are in model.json. The game
             downloads it into your data folder the first time it can play
             with AI.
Source:      https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E4B-it (base model)
Included in: none (downloaded)
License:     Apache License 2.0 (Gemma 4 license:
             https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license)
Text:        licenses/Apache-2.0.txt


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Not shipped
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
doctest (the test framework of the engine) is used only to build the tests
and is not part of any package.
